title: DataWorks needs senior data architects
body: DataWorks Ltd is a growing software services company. It has won a large contract that requires five senior data architects with at least ten years of experience in designing large databases. None of its present analysts has this experience, and the company does not have time to develop them. The HR head wants a wide choice of experienced candidates and wishes to bring fresh ideas into the company. She is considering a firm that specialises in middle and top level executive placements, maintains a data bank of professionals and can screen candidates on the company's behalf. Some of the present analysts, however, have already said that they hoped these senior posts would go to them.
